## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-fascicle late-Míng / early-Qīng commentary (*suíwén lù* 隨聞錄, "record of what was heard along with the text") on the famous Táng-period *Shuǐ chàn* 水懺 attributed to **Wùdá guóshī** 悟達國師 (i.e. *Cíbēi shuǐchànfǎ* 慈悲水懺法, T1910 / [KR6c0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0007)). Composed by **Zhòuzhōng Zhìzhèng** 晝中智證 ([智證](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E8%AD%89)), a disciple of *Gāofēng Bàopú Dàlián chánshī* 高峰抱璞大蓮禪師 (?–1629), while resident at the *Qīngluóān* 青螺菴 in Gǔlóu 古婁 (Tàicāng 太倉). The commentary parses the *Shuǐ chàn*'s opening titulus and its sin-categories one phrase at a time, weaving in scriptural citations from both *zàng* 藏 collections, classical historical exempla (the袁盎/晁錯 backstory of Wùdá's *rénmiàn chuāng* 人面瘡 affair), and Tiāntái-school doctrinal annotations.

**Abstract**

The *Suíwén lù* is a discursive Tiāntái-school *zhùshū* 註疏 on the perennially-popular *Shuǐ chàn*. Its principal contribution is its synthesis: Zhìzhèng "first collated the canonical prooftexts of the two *piṭakas*, then digested the explanations of the worthies, and selected what was reliable" (先覈兩藏之原文。次簡諸賢之疏釋。摭其確當). The work survived only patchily after the late-Qīng wars and was reissued in 1895 from a recovered manuscript by Ruìbīn at Yìwúsì in Hángzhōu — the woodblock edition reproduced in the Xùzàngjīng. The compiler Zhìzhèng's life-dates are not preserved ; since his teacher died in 1629, his floruit must lie in the second quarter of the 17th century, with the commentary very likely composed in the mid-Qīng — `notBefore` and `notAfter` are bracketed loosely (1620–1680) accordingly. For the parent text see [KR6c0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0007) (T1910 *Cíbēi shuǐchànfǎ*).
